news_headlines.title: Silver Lake funds trim Dell (NYSE: DELL) stake with Class C share sales
news_headlines.summary: Investment funds affiliated with Silver Lake, who are directors and 10% owners of Dell Technologies Inc., sold 382,000 Class C Common Stock shares on April 15-16, 2026, at prices ranging from $176.50 to $193.75 per share, after converting Class B shares. The filing also detailed in-kind, pro rata distributions of Class C shares to their investors and personnel, which are exempt from reporting under Rule 16a-13. Dell director Egon Durban maintains a direct holding of 1,313,489 Class C shares and additional indirect interests following these transactions.

news_headlines.title: Silver Lake entities adjust Dell (DELL) stake with conversions and $176–$181 share sales

These transactions occurred on April 15 and 16, 2026, with sales prices ranging from $176.30 to $180.8671 per share. Despite these sales, Silver Lake entities, including director Egon Durban, maintain significant direct and indirect holdings in Dell.

(NASDAQ:DELL) Class C Common Stock for approximately $81.2 million on April 15, 2026. Despite the sales, Dell's stock has risen to $196.55, marking a 54% year-to-date gain and trading near its 52-week high with a 132% increase over the past year. Analysts from Wolfe Research, BofA Securities, Mizuho, and Evercore ISI have offered varied perspectives on Dell, with most increasing price targets due to strong AI infrastructure demand.

news_headlines.title: Dell (DELL) COO Jeffrey Clarke sells 116,000 shares in pre-set 10b5-1 trade
